description: Single source of truth for gate AprilTag IDs.
Per the challenge, gates carry tags 5-13 while 1-4 stay reserved for the
intersection signs. The gate ORDER for the timed run is announced on site
and given as tag IDs (see launch arg 'gate_order') - it is never derived
from colour, so the colours below are purely cosmetic: they make the logs
and the visualization readable. Any tag may physically be any colour.
'colour' is the human-readable name used in logs, 'hex' is what
visualization.py draws. Consumers must treat this file as advisory: an
unknown ID still maps to a usable fallback.
